project.name: Newpeak Todo Webboard
project.primary_goal: Newpeak team members can view, create, complete, and track operational tasks from one lightweight web app.

single_file_frontend.decision: Keep index.html as the frontend execution unit.
single_file_frontend.reason: Project has no frontend build pipeline, and existing project rules forbid CSS/JS splitting.

ida_master_index.decision: Use this file as the master index for modules, data sources, automations, defects, and documentation.

sda_layer_mapping.decision: Map SDA layers onto existing files instead of moving execution files into new folders.

deployment_gate.decision: Commit, push, and deployment require explicit user request because GitHub push triggers Netlify deployment.

browser_app.owner_area: single-page UI, client state, Notion data orchestration
browser_app.last_verified: 2026-05-19: inline script syntax PASS; promotion channel hue fallback smoke PASS

netlify_deployment_config.owner_area: Netlify function path and cache behavior

agent_instructions.owner_area: Codex operating rules and architecture pointers

syntax_smoke_test.owner_area: minimal syntax regression gate for inline browser script and Netlify proxy

architecture_knowledge.owner_area: IDA master index, architecture, workflow, defect, and glossary records

setup_and_auth.owner_area: Notion token setup, localStorage state, Google Calendar auth

todo_calendar.owner_area: calendar selection, week range, carried tasks, weekly completed tasks

performance_crm.owner_area: CRM event cards, Notion callouts, Cloudinary images, Markdown export

design_requests.owner_area: design request board and status updates

content_requests.owner_area: content request board and status updates

rendering.owner_area: single render loop and UI templates

notion_weekly_tasks.freshness_rule: Loaded per selected date/user and completed-month cache
notion_weekly_tasks.fallback: local cache in S.tasks during current browser session

notion_fixed_schedule.fallback: empty schedule with toast on failure

notion_design_requests.freshness_rule: Loaded when Design team tab is selected
notion_design_requests.fallback: empty request list with toast on failure

notion_content_requests.freshness_rule: Loaded when Content team tab is selected
notion_content_requests.fallback: empty request list with toast on failure

notion_crm_events.freshness_rule: Loaded when Performance CRM calendar mode is selected
notion_crm_events.fallback: empty CRM list with toast on failure

google_calendar_youtube.freshness_rule: Loaded after Google auth token is available
